data.one_liner: Secure storage of strings via iOS Keychain and Android Keystore.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin to securely store, retrieve, remove, and clear string values using native platform security mechanisms like Keychain on iOS and Keystore on Android. It supports optional iOS access groups and item labels.
use_when: You need to store sensitive string data like auth tokens or credentials securely on the device
You target iOS and Android and want native secure storage integration
avoid_when: You need to store complex object types without serializing them to strings first
You need cross-platform secure storage for platforms beyond Android and iOS (like web or desktop)
strengths: Leverages native iOS Keychain and Android Keystore mechanisms
Supports configuration options for iOS access groups and item labels
Handles threading issues on Android to prevent ANR errors
weaknesses: Only supports storing strings; other types require manual serialization
Limited platform support (primarily Android and iOS)
data.setup_notes: On Android, set minSdkVersion to >= 18 in build.gradle.

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: More widely used feature-rich alternative for secure storage across multiple platforms.
